subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar believes the shifting passages of the Underdark are to be expected and that finding an exit through their current location is remarkably convenient.
source_quote: He insisted that the shifting passages were to be expected and that finding an exit through their current location was remarkably convenient

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a skeptic who predicts that their situation will end in tears, meaning some unfortunate event will befall them before they reach safety.
source_quote: Thorin, ever the skeptic, predicted that this situation would end in tears, meaning some unfortunate event would befall them before they reached safety

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar proposed a wager on whether tears—literal or metaphorical—would mark their journey.
source_quote: Jimjar, never one to pass up an opportunity, proposed a wager on whether tears—literal or metaphorical—would indeed mark their journey

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin accepted the bet on whether tears would mark their journey.
source_quote: After carefully defining the terms, Thorin accepted the bet

subject: Daz
fact: Daz investigated and confirmed that an earthquake had caused an underground reservoir to crack open, and water was pouring into the cave system.
source_quote: Daz investigated further and confirmed the dire situation: an earthquake had caused an underground reservoir to crack open, and water was pouring into the cave system

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool was once an ordinary gelatinous cube, mindlessly cleaning floors and consuming debris, but recently gained the ability to think and speak.
source_quote: Glabbagool explained that he had once been an ordinary cube, mindlessly cleaning floors and consuming debris, but had recently gained the ability to think and speak

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is confused by his newfound sentience but eager to understand the world around him.
source_quote: He was confused by his newfound sentience but eager to understand the world around him

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin invited Glabbagool to join their adventure after seeing an opportunity for both companionship and utility.
source_quote: Thorin, seeing an opportunity for both companionship and utility, invited Glabbagool to join their adventure

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool agreed enthusiastically to join the party and promised to eat anything they dropped on the floor.
source_quote: The cube agreed enthusiastically, promising to eat anything they dropped on the floor

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool expressed gratitude when Thorin offered him a lucky foot as a welcoming gift.
source_quote: expressing gratitude when Thorin offered him a lucky foot as a welcoming gift

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin barely managed to grab the edge of a hidden pit trap and pull himself out before a black pudding emerged.
source_quote: Thorin fell victim to a hidden pit trap, barely managing to grab the edge and pull himself out before a black pudding emerged from the depths

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stepped forward without hesitation and struck the gray ooze with a series of powerful blows from his bare fists.
source_quote: Zalthir stepped forward without hesitation, striking the creature with a series of powerful blows from his bare fists

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin attempted to engage the oozes from a distance by shooting darts at them, hoping to avoid the creatures' corrosive touch.
source_quote: Thorin attempted to engage the oozes from a distance by shooting darts at them, hoping to avoid the creatures' corrosive touch

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool inadvertently blocked the narrow passage with his ten-foot-by-ten-foot body.
source_quote: Glabbagool—a massive gelatinous cube they had just befriended—inadvertently blocked the narrow passage with his ten-foot-by-ten-foot body

subject: The party
fact: The party gently suggested that Glabbagool might be better suited to the rear of their formation.
source_quote: The party gently suggested that their new companion might be better suited to the rear of their formation

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finished off one of the gray oozes with a devastating spell.
source_quote: Daz finished off one of the gray oozes with a devastating spell

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool cheerfully acknowledged that perhaps he should indeed stay in the back.
source_quote: Glabbagool cheerfully acknowledged that perhaps he should indeed stay in the back

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool volunteered to investigate the chamber with the formless sculptures first, offering to touch them to see what would happen.
source_quote: Glabbagool volunteered to investigate the room first, offering to touch the mysterious sculptures to see what would happen

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir sprang into action and dispatched the gray ooze that materialized from the formless sculpture with a flurry of precise strikes.
source_quote: Zalthir sprang into action, dispatching the creature with a flurry of precise strikes

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool meticulously cleaned up the remnants of each ooze, leaving the floor spotless.
source_quote: Glabbagool meticulously cleaned up the remnants, leaving the floor spotless

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool discovered a hidden cache of treasure in the fountain: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness.
source_quote: Glabbagool investigated the fountain itself and discovered a hidden cache of treasure: one hundred twelve silver pieces, three gold pieces, a drow dagger, and a vial of oil of slipperiness

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin examined the cracks in the ceiling and concluded that the entire complex was slowly flooding.
source_quote: Thorin, drawing on his dwarven experience with caves and geology, examined the cracks and concluded that the entire complex was slowly flooding

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth recognized the phenomenon as an underground river breaking through the stone.
source_quote: Eldeth, another dwarf in the party, recognized the phenomenon as an underground river breaking through the stone

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth warned of the risk of causing the water to flood even faster if they broke through the rock.
source_quote: She also warned of the risk of causing the water to flood even faster

subject: The party
fact: The party decided to proceed with a plan to create air pockets using magic to move safely through the flooded passages.
source_quote: They decided to proceed with this plan, creating a progression of air pockets and advancing five feet at a time

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool confirmed that he did not need to breathe, making him immune to the drowning threat.
source_quote: Glabbagool confirmed that he did not need to breathe, making him immune to the drowning threat

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool agreed to allow the party to attempt resurrection on any fallen members before consuming them.
source_quote: he agreed to allow the party to attempt resurrection on any fallen members before consuming them

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin used his considerable strength to break through the wall, causing more of the ceiling to collapse and doubling the water flow.
source_quote: Thorin used his considerable strength to break through the wall, causing more of the ceiling to collapse and doubling the water flow

subject: The party
fact: The party swam upward for about thirty feet through the newly revealed passage and successfully reached the surface.
source_quote: As the water level rose to the ceiling, the party swam upward for about thirty feet through the newly revealed passage. They successfully reached the surface

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar declared that the adventure had not ended in tears after all.
source_quote: Jimjar declared that the adventure had not ended in tears after all

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar offered to call the bet a draw due to the charming and helpful Glabbagool joining their ranks.
source_quote: he offered to call the bet a draw due to the charming and helpful Glabbagool joining their ranks

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin agreed to call the bet a draw.
source_quote: Thorin agreed

subject: Glabbagool's origin
fact: Glabbagool's sudden sentience and ability to speak are unexplained beyond his own confusion and eagerness to understand.
source_quote: He was confused by his newfound sentience but eager to understand the world around him

subject: The formless sculptures
fact: The nature and origin of the formless sculptures in the chamber are not specified, only that they materialize into oozes when touched.
source_quote: seven niches were carved into the walls, some empty and others holding strange, formless sculptures

subject: The stone fountain
fact: The purpose and history of the stone fountain filled with brackish water are not explained.
source_quote: a stone fountain filled with shallow, brackish water

subject: The broken statue
fact: The identity and significance of the broken statue atop the pedestal are not revealed.
source_quote: A broken statue rested atop a pedestal in the center

subject: The party
fact: The party acknowledged they would need to wait a few days for Glabbagool to digest and pass the hidden treasure.
source_quote: The party acknowledged that they would need to wait a few days for Glabbagool to digest and pass the items

subject: The party
fact: The party celebrated their narrow escape, grateful for their new friend and the unexpected shortcut to Blingdenstone.
source_quote: the party celebrated their narrow escape, grateful for their new friend and the unexpected shortcut to Blingdenstone
